ns2:section.sectionText: Math 347 is restricted to students currently in majors requiring the course. Major restrictions will be removed during business hours on April 22, 2022 for math minors and all other students. Students hoping to transfer to Mathematics should email mathadvising@illinois.edu for course advising. Some seats are reserved for off-campus math transfer students and will not be released until business hours on the Friday before fall classes begin.
